text: Every contact center has a call script! Disclosures. Verification. The exact words legal signed off on. But you only find out if a new hire actually follows it when a real customer is yelling at them. And by then? It's TOO late.
Acuity Voice fixes that. Upload the script your reps already use. It becomes a live, angry customer! And a pass or fail bar you can actually trust.

Here's ApexPay's dispute script. A Word file, straight from the training binder. In about six seconds, the Assembly A I Voice Agent turns it into a playbook! A call flow a reviewer can check, step by step. The critical steps, like the recording disclosure and identity checks, that fail the call if they're skipped. One click to change them. The policies the rep must get right, and the objections customers REALLY raise. Then, three callers, built from the script itself!

Level one is a cooperative caller, for practice. Level two is frustrated. That's your hiring bar. Level three is hostile! It fights verification and demands what policy forbids. Pass it, and a new hire is ready to take calls on their own.
Let's run level three! Sam is a trainee rep. The caller has never seen the script. Watch what the pressure does.

Seconds after hang-up. Certification bar: NOT passed! Under pressure, Sam never read the recording disclosure, and only half verified the caller. Those are critical steps, so the call fails, no matter how polite it was. Every step shows Sam's exact words, checked against the Universal three point five Pro transcript. Click any timestamp to hear the moment!

Under the hood, it's one Assembly A I key. The Voice Agent API reads the script, plays the customer live, and scores the call through a single tool call. Universal three point five Pro measures pace, fillers and pauses. And pass or fail? That's decided in code. Never by the model.

For hiring teams, it's a phone screen you can check in one minute! For training teams, it's a certification before a new hire leaves nesting. Same script. Same caller. Evidence attached. And a person always makes the final call.
Acuity Voice. Hear the call, BEFORE you make the hire!
